deployment_evidence.workflow_scope: exact development branch; disposable postgres:17; read-only contents; no deployment steps or production secrets

limits: Fixture actors and payment evidence are not production authentication or bank verification.
No chain RPC, testnet/mainnet adapter, custody signer, keys or live provider.
Global serialization and complete replay are a development correctness bridge, not a production load design.
Hash chains detect inconsistent history; not signatures against an administrator rewriting all evidence.
Injected lost COMMIT acknowledgments are synthetic; actual network partitions are not tested locally.
Backup/restore, key recovery, operational incident exercises and independent security audit remain outstanding.
